{{External|rs|rsc=Iron Plate Mail Body|dw=Iron Platebody}} {{Infobox Item |name = Iron platebody |image = [[File:Iron platebody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = Provides excellent protection. |value = 560 |weight = 9.979 |respawn = 1500 |exchange = Yes |id = 1115 }} [[File:Iron platebody detail.png|150px|left]] The '''iron platebody''' is an armour used in [[melee]] with stat bonuses between [[Bronze platebody|bronze]] and [[Steel platebody|steel]]. It has no [[Defence]] requirement to equip, which makes it the best platebody for players just starting out. It also provides greater protection than an [[iron chainbody]]. Like all [[Platebody|platebodies]], however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] stats. If playing as an [[Ironman Mode|Ironman]], an [[ironman platebody]] with equivalent stats can be acquired by talking to the [[Ironman tutor]] in [[Lumbridge]]. Players with level 33 [[Smithing]] can make one by using 5 [[iron bar]]s on an [[anvil]] while carrying a [[hammer]], granting 125 [[experience]]. Alternatively, they can be bought from [[Horvik's Smithy]] or [[Zenesha's Plate Mail Body Shop]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -30 |arange = -15 |dstab = +21 |dslash = +20 |dcrush = +12 |dmagic = -6 |drange = +20 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Iron platebody equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Iron platebody equipped female.png|170px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 33 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 125 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Iron bar |mat1quantity = 5 |output1 = Iron platebody }} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Iron platebody}} ===Spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Iron platebody|location=[[Prifddinas]] - on a table in [[Aneirin's Armour]]|members=Yes|mapID=29|3253,6060|leagueRegion=Tirannwn}} {{ItemSpawnTableBottom}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Iron platebody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The platebody's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -10 to -15. }} {{Subject changes |date = 7 March 2005 |update = Mountain Daughter and Changes |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Iron platebody detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Iron platebody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Iron platebody (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Iron platebody.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
